description: Teamwork acceptance and release parity correction
changelog: Preserve beta.1 teamwork and lifecycle changes; include the canonical workflow scripts in the source commit so released scripts match bundled templates.
migrationGuide: Upgrade through the beta channel to 0.7.2-beta.2, then run the native trellis update command. Existing customized project files remain subject to the normal preview and conflict review. Teamwork batches remain pending coordinator review until each report receives an explicit accepted or final_failed disposition; attempt evidence remains until explicit cleanup.
aiInstructions: The CLI owns FIFO dispatch, retries, background monitoring, and batch recovery. Teammates submit conclusions and evidence only. After the full batch returns, the main agent reviews each report and records a disposition bound to its digest and frozen acceptance contract. Preserve attempt evidence and use native reconcile, review, retry, and cleanup-artifacts commands. Unknown process identity remains fail closed unless explicitly confirmed through the auditable native reconciliation entry point.
notes: Keep the beta npm channel. 0.7.2-beta.2 is above stable 0.7.1; do not move the latest tag.
